title: Fix Render boot 57014 migration lock timeout
summary: Render start failed with canceling statement due to statement timeout (57014) because session pg_advisory_lock orphaned under PgBouncer. Boot migrate now skips the lock when nothing is pending and uses pg_advisory_xact_lock + SET LOCAL statement_timeout=0 when applying.
testFocus: Render backend start succeeds (no Auto-migrate failed / 57014)
Logs show Auto-migrate complete: no pending files when DB is up to date
productionChecks: Render Deploy: service starts; npm start does not exit 1
Optional: API /health returns ok after redeploy

deploy.expected: Push main ? Render backend redeploy; start must succeed

asIs: Boot acquired session advisory lock; under PgBouncer the lock could stick on an idle backend; next deploy waited then hit 30s statement_timeout 57014 and refused to start.
toBe: No lock when migrations already applied; pending applies use transaction-scoped advisory lock and no 30s migrate timeout.
